title: Anth.us-Papyrus: keep shared link previews working (old Gatsby /static/ og:image URLs)
description: Live Gatsby pages set og:image/twitter:image to https://anth.us/static/<hash>/<hash>/<file>. Every link already shared on social media embeds those URLs, and they will 404 after cutover, so existing previews lose their images. Minimal fix (YAGNI): for each article, read the og:image URL from the verified production build (/Users/home/Projects/Anth.us-live/public/**/index.html), map it to the port's corresponding image file, and emit an Amplify 301 rule from the old /static/... path to the new image URL (generated by web/anthus_urls.py alongside the legacy page rules, before the 404 catch-all). Only og:image/twitter:image URLs; not every /static/ rendition. Verify a handful live after deploy.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Integrated on AnthusAI/Anth.us-Papyrus branch feature/anthus-integration @ 7b7f339 (design-parity base + env/staging guards + real-404 merged; pin c98435f; pushed, no PR, not deployed). 106 og:image/twitter:image 301 rules generated in anthus_urls.legacy_rules from web/legacy-og-images.json (extracted by bin/extract-legacy-og-images.py from the live build), before the 404 catch-all; guards: no shadowing, no chains, targets exist in dist. simulate-redirects over all 106 old URLs: 106 redirect, 0 chain/dead/404. Still verify a few live after deploy.
